description: This Java source file implements the DefaultMetadataHeaders class, which is a thread-unsafe, final class extending AbstractSet<MetadataHeader> and implementing MetadataHeaders interface. It manages a collection of MetadataHeader objects in a sorted set, providing methods for creation, parsing from JSON, JSON serialization, and collection operations. The class includes functionality for parsing JSON array input into MetadataHeaders, converting headers to JSON, and standard set operations.
